args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Beach & Water Activities:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses with UV protection
- Wide-brimmed hat
- Beach bag
- Flip-flops/water shoes
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Waterproof phone case
- Rash guard/swim shirt

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Comfortable hiking shoes/boots
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Moisture-wicking t-shirts
- Light jacket or rain jacket
- Daypack/backpack
- Water bottle/hydration pack
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit

Clothing:
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light, breathable clothing
- One nicer outfit for the luau
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments
- Socks

Electronics:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Universal travel adapter
- Headphones

Toiletries:
- Personal medications
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Contact lenses/solution (if needed)

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for day trips
- Book or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Small umbrella
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (if required)

Special Activities:
- Spa day items (June 17)
- Shopping list for Ala Moana Center (June 19)
